propositions: Project routing overlay cannot extend built-in code-review overlay triggers; only standalone project.* criteria are supported today
The mechanism needs to allow projects to add trigger vocabulary (literal substrings and glob patterns) to built-in overlay ids like concurrency and performance

A new helper function should read project overlay trigger extensions and union them with committed triggers in glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays without replacing committed values
Project trigger_tokens should match literal substrings case-sensitively against added and removed lines of unified diffs, excluding file headers
Malformed project trigger entries (non-list tokens, non-string values, unknown overlay ids) should be silently ignored during consumption
